description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dedurunadeegama, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420051
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, and land classification details. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and title registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
